name: Tinker - AWESOME
description: Allows you to build the AWESOME Shop and AWESOME Sink wherever you settle, given materials and a 30-megawatt power feed for the Sink. The Sink recycles anything you feed it into FICSIT coupons, raw ores worth least, complex tech most, each further coupon costing progressively more feedstock. The Shop spends coupons on Satisfactory gacha entries (10 coupons per rarity level), building-part blueprints and customizations, and small shipments of consumables, equipment, and parts; pioneering awards and statues arrive with tickets attached. For more info: https://satisfactory.wiki.gg/wiki/AWESOME_Shop
